profile.headline: Senior Web Developer
profile.summary:
Web Developer, using CFML, php, Javascript, JQuery, JQuery UI, JQueryMobile, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS, XML. Always interested in applications using the best platforms available.

Specialties: jQuery, jQuery UI, Bootstrap, CFML, php, XML, HTML, CSS, Wordpress, Javascript,  AJAX. Photoshop, GIMP, IIS, WAMP, LAMP, ORACLE, MySQL, SQL Server 2008+, COLDFUSION, Railo, SVN, Git, AWS, GCP

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Supporting and developing web applications using Lucee, CFML, jQuery, JQueryUI, JQueryMobile, CSS, SQL Server, MySQL, Wordpress, php, and e-commerce API's such as Authorize.net.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Working with ColdFusion 2016, php, jQuery, jQuery UI, Bootstrap, MS-SQL Server 2008 R2+,  Also working with Braintree Payments, Afterpay, UPS/FEDEX (shipping, landed cost, returns), TaxJar APIs, SVN, Git. Internal user support (rotating basis) for frontend, backend applications.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Develop and support new and current business intelligence data products using industry tools such as ColdFusion, jQuery, ORACLE, SQL Server and whatever else is available to create rich internet applications.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed high quality, database-driven websites using available tools and technologies including CFML, PHP, Flex, XML, HTML/DHTML, AJAX, classic ASP, SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, Wordpress, Omniture, and Google Analytics.

Achieved significant milestones and completed projects in a timely fashion, collaborating extensively with project manager and business users as tech lead for development life cycle, including definition, database design, application architecture, development, system/integration, testing, change requests, deployment, and maintenance/management of all available off-shore and on-shore development resources.

Designed and developed production processes for data and news syndication to clients using VB, CFML, RSS and SQL DTS. Customized feed formats which were delivered daily via an automated batch process using FTP.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Provided technical support to 200 CBM employees in 10 states and Montreal, Canada by managing production of Windows 2000 / NT / OpenVMS servers, firewalls, and network infrastructure.

Achieved 200% performance increase through streamlining of email processing by implementing a hub structure that quickly and effectively routed SMTP traffic to proper destinations.

Enhanced security by deploying a proxy firewall and VPN tunnel server to secure external remote network connections.

positions.title: Network Administrator (Consultant)
positions.description:
Managed all Windows NT / 2000 servers and workstations and networking infrastructure, including server administration, user login management, system backups, server troubleshooting, workstations, and network problems.

Reduced costs by providing network support to 50 users via remote management, phone, and on-site presence, thereby allowing company to function without a dedicated, on-site, full-time IT staff member.

Improved productivity by establishing an Internet connection that allowed for faster communication via e-mail.

Minimized downtime by upgrading servers and workstation to Windows 2000 from Windows 98 / NT and increased overall network performance by migrating to 100BaseT switches from shared 10BaseT hubs.

positions.title: MTS/Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Managed the OpenVMS test lab environment of the billing / provisioning system used for wireless devices deployed within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, providing server maintenance, system backups, upgrades, capacity planning, and troubleshooting any server and network infrastructure problems.

Enhanced productivity on OpenVMS system of 20 individuals on the development and testing teams by providing training necessary for them to manage their own development and test environments.

Strengthened lab security by implementing server and database security via SecurID PINPAD cards.

Streamlined tracking of all software modification requests by funneling them through the Sablime request system, providing management for the test team with feedback from the development team.

Improved application performance by developing database tuning and deadlock prevention strategies.

positions.title: Systems Manager
positions.description:
Facilitated smooth operations by managing all academic and administrative Windows and OpenVMS servers and workstations, including user login management, system backups, updates and upgrades, troubleshooting  workstation and network problems.

Assured business continuity in the event of disaster affecting the main datacenter by developing a disaster recovery plan, including set up of remotely hosted hot site, restoration of data from off-site backups, and instructions on when the site would be used and how staff would be transported there.
